name: Air
mood: Midnight sky through glass sculpture, with full-bleed cloud photography, sculptural translucent forms, flat ghost controls, and restrained medium-weight typography.

whiteout.role: Primary text on dark surfaces, nav button borders, hairline strokes, and card surfaces over photographic backgrounds.

haze.role: Card surfaces, input fields, and subtle button fills on dark backgrounds.

ink.role: Body and heading text on light surfaces, button borders on light cards.

blackVoid.role: Base background behind photographic sections, footer, and dark UI moments.

twilightBlue.role: Heading text on dark backgrounds, desaturated and atmospheric rather than vivid.

signalBlue.role: Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not use for buttons or backgrounds.

surfaces.name: Dark Canvas
surfaces.purpose: Base background behind photographic sections, footer, and dark UI moments.

surfaces.name: Haze Card
surfaces.purpose: Light card surface sitting on top of dark photography.

surfaces.name: Whiteout
surfaces.purpose: Pure white for text, borders, and elevated form surfaces.

do: Use Control at weight 500 for body, nav, button, and link text.
Set all buttons and interactive elements to 8px radius.
Apply 4px radius to form inputs only.
Use Haze for card surfaces and inputs on dark backgrounds.
Use Whiteout for borders and text on dark surfaces.
Use Ink for text and borders on light surfaces.
Break headlines with one italic word in Control Cursive against upright Control TNT or Control.
Let photography and glass forms carry the emotional weight.
dont: Do not use solid filled colored buttons.
Do not apply shadows or elevation to cards.
Do not use more than one saturated accent color per page.
Do not set body text below 16px or above weight 500.
Do not use rounded pill shapes except for toggle or filter controls.
Do not introduce new radii outside 4px, 8px, 11px to 14px, and 12px.
Do not make the UI busier than the photography.
